baseline_models.focus_anchor: جعل لكم الأرض قرارا والسماء بناء
baseline_models.mechanism: The benefactive construction joins a lower stable surface to an upper built cover: assigned state, settlement, elevation, and assembly cooperate as one inhabitable spatial system.

activation_trace.role: Making something into an assigned state coordinates the distinct functions given to earth and sky.
The lower realm opposite the sky supplies the habitat's supporting side.
Fixity and settlement make the lower realm usable as a place of sustained occupancy.
What is raised and shades supplies the habitat's upper covering.
Assembly by joining parts makes the upper realm read as constructed order rather than empty height.

changed_reading.before: Earth and sky are two items in a list of created things.
changed_reading.after: Earth and sky are complementary structural functions in a deliberately coordinated habitat: settled base below and raised cover above.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وصوركم فأحسن صوركم ورزقكم من الطيبات ذلكم الله ربكم
baseline_models.mechanism: The same agent gives human form, brings that form into goodness, assigns nourishing goods, and is then named Lord; formation and continuing sustenance jointly define care.

activation_trace.role: The doubled verbal and nominal form image makes bodily configuration an intentional act and result.
Beneficent, well-executed action makes the forming not merely visual but functionally good.
An apportioned gift extends the act of forming into continued maintenance.
Good, wholesome provision gives the maintenance a qualitative fitness for its recipients.
Repair, nurture, and completion gather bodily formation and provision under an active account of lordship.

changed_reading.before: Good appearance and food are separate favors followed by a divine title.
changed_reading.after: Well-formed embodiment and fitting sustenance are one continuing economy of nurture, and that economy explicates 'your Lord.'

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier clause in 40:13 makes provision descend from the sky. Returned to 40:64, sky-building and provision cease to be adjacent but independent gifts and become an upper delivery layer feeding the settled habitat.

activation_trace.role: The elevated, shading sky supplies the upper member of the focus architecture.
Joined construction gives that upper member ordered structural agency.
The rain-as-provision branch allows the focus provision to connect materially to the upper structure.
Delivery downward supplies the motion linking upper source to lower recipient.
The explicitly named sky locates the source side of that delivery.
Descending rain named as provision closes the supplied sky-to-sustenance link.

structural_cues: 40:13 places descent, sky, and provision in one clause; 40:64 later places sky-building and provision in one sentence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a sky-to-provision descent in 40:13 and sky-building plus provision in 40:64; I infer that the earlier directional relation integrates the later items into one circuit. A live alternative is that 40:64 simply catalogs two favors without carrying over the direction.

changed_reading.before: The sky is a protective construction, while provision is a separate gift.
changed_reading.after: The built sky is also a delivery interface through which the habitat is supplied.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding parallel 'made for you' clause assigns night to stillness and day to visibility. It turns the focus habitat from a static enclosure into an environment operated by alternating phases of rest and perceptibility.

activation_trace.role: Settlement supplies the stable spatial condition that the temporal cycle serves.
Construction supplies the ordered enclosure whose use can vary by phase.
The repeated assigning construction formally links the temporal functions to the focus spatial functions.
Cessation of movement supplies the restorative phase of the habitat.
Day's opening by light supplies the contrasting active phase.
Visual availability makes daytime an enabling condition rather than merely a time label.

structural_cues: 40:61 immediately precedes the focus and repeats 'Allah who made for you' before assigning paired environmental functions.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies parallel syntax and the rest/visibility alternation; I infer that this temporal alternation is the operating rhythm of the spatial habitat in 40:64. The live alternative is a sequence of independent favors linked only rhetorically.

changed_reading.before: Earthly settlement is chiefly static stability beneath a built sky.
changed_reading.after: Settlement is stable without being inert: the built habitat works through an alternating regime of stillness and visibility.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same settlement root appears in 40:39 inside 'the abode of settlement,' while worldly life there is enjoyment. The contrast distinguishes genuine present habitability from finality: the earth can be a real place of settlement without being the ultimate settled abode.

activation_trace.role: Fixity and residence anchor the focus claim that earth supports settled life.
Enjoyable benefit characterizes the worldly domain by use rather than final permanence.
Settlement attached to the later abode supplies the comparative horizon for the focus earth.

structural_cues: 40:39 explicitly contrasts worldly life with the later 'abode of settlement' before 40:64 calls earth a settlement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the same root across a domain contrast; I infer that the earlier contrast limits the scale, not the reality, of earthly settlement. A live alternative is that the two occurrences name unrelated kinds of stability and do not qualify one another.

changed_reading.before: Calling earth a settlement can sound like an unqualified declaration of permanent home.
changed_reading.after: Earth is a genuinely stable and usable residence, but its stability is provisional when measured against the final abode of settlement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The measured-creation branch and the ordered sequence of dust, drop, attachment, emergence, maturity, and term unfold what the focus telescopes into 'formed you and made good your forms.' Good form becomes the achieved coordination of transitions, not cosmetic finish alone.

activation_trace.role: The doubled form image supplies the visible configuration whose process the context unfolds.
Well-executed beneficence lets goodness describe successful formation, not appearance alone.
Nurture from state to state supplies the governing continuity across the developmental sequence.
Measured estimation supplies an ordering principle for the stages rather than an undifferentiated event.
A minute water-drop state supplies an early material phase.
A pregnancy that attaches and becomes established supplies continuity from material state toward formed body.
Reaching maturity and a named term supplies developmental endpoints within the same trajectory.

structural_cues: 40:67 repeatedly marks transitions with ثم and moves from material origins through childhood, maturity, old age, and a named term.
40:57 places cosmic creation and human creation in one explicit comparison.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measured creation and a staged human sequence; I infer that the compact focus verb retrospectively gathers that process into its achieved form. A live alternative is that 40:64 refers only to the finished visible shape.

changed_reading.before: God gave humans an attractive finished appearance.
changed_reading.after: The good human form is the successful, nurtured outcome of a measured sequence of transformations.

context_deltas.mechanism: Pharaoh commissions a high structure in order to reach and inspect the ways of the heavens. Against that attempted architecture, the focus names the sky itself as God's building and immediately identifies its maker as Lord; construction becomes a contest over who can author and interpret the upper order.

activation_trace.role: True assembly of the sky anchors the focus claim about the maker of the upper structure.
Sovereignty and ownership make the architectural contrast a claim about rightful lordship.
The imperative to build supplies a humanly commissioned construction parallel.
A high building gives the rival project its upward architectural form.
Reaching a goal supplies the tower's instrumental purpose.
The heavens are explicitly the domain the commissioned structure seeks to access.
Looking out to uncover a matter makes the structure an attempted instrument of inspection.

structural_cues: 40:36-37 runs from a command to build, through a high structure and attempted reaching, to looking toward the heavens.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a human building aimed at the heavens and later calls the sky God's building; I supply the counter-architecture relation and the sovereignty arrow. A live alternative is that the shared building vocabulary is incidental and the episodes remain separate.

changed_reading.before: The sky-as-building image describes ordered shelter.
changed_reading.after: The sky-as-building also answers a failed ruler's commissioned ascent: the real upper architecture identifies its maker, not the claimant who tries to inspect it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus stands immediately after denial of God's signs and later inside the surah's show-sign-deny sequence. Its earth, sky, human form, and provision therefore function not only as benefits but as displayed evidence, with 'that is Allah, your Lord' performing the identification the signs solicit.

activation_trace.role: Deliberately configured form supplies a visible human instance of the focus evidence.
Perceptible goodness gives the configured form evaluative force.
A manifest sign supplies the category that the following focus details concretize.
Denial despite knowledge supplies the recognition failure to which the focus responds.
Causing something to be seen makes display an explicit divine action.
Repeated manifest signs frame the displayed world as evidence rather than neutral scenery.
The opposite of recognition names the failed response to what has been shown.

structural_cues: 40:63 immediately precedes the focus with denial of God's signs.
40:81 closes a later benefits sequence by asking which displayed signs are denied.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sign-denial immediately before the focus and show-sign-deny afterward; I infer that the focus inventory is a concrete evidentiary display. A live alternative is that the focus is praise and benefaction only, while the sign language merely frames the wider section.

changed_reading.before: The verse enumerates favors and then praises their giver.
changed_reading.after: The favors are also a visible argument whose demonstrative conclusion identifies their maker as the hearer's Lord.

context_deltas.mechanism: Just before the focus, 'your Lord' commands a call and promises an answer. The focus then grounds that responsive relation in habitat, embodiment, and provision: lordship is not a detached title but care that can be addressed.

activation_trace.role: Nurture and completion make the focus title relational and active.
Apportioned provision supplies a concrete mode of that active care.
The same nurturing title is the speaker of the invitation immediately before the focus.
Calling by speech supplies the human side of the relation.
Answering speech supplies the promised divine return.

structural_cues: 40:60 introduces 'your Lord' as speaker of a call-and-answer pair shortly before 40:64 repeats 'your Lord.'
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacency, repeated lordship, and an explicit call-answer pair; I infer that the created habitat and provision ground the credibility of responsive care. A live alternative is that the invitation and the creation list are parallel proofs without a relational mechanism between them.

changed_reading.before: 'Your Lord' summarizes ownership after the listed favors.
changed_reading.after: 'Your Lord' names the nurturing agent who forms, supplies, invites address, and promises response.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later repeated 'made for you' construction expands benefit into riding, eating, reaching needs, and being carried by ships. It prevents the focus's settled earth from becoming an image of immobility: the stable habitat is fitted with channels of movement and use.

activation_trace.role: Stable settlement supplies the dependable base from which controlled movement becomes useful.
Nourishing provision anchors one of the practical uses later made explicit.
The repeated assignment for human benefit links the later affordances to the focus syntax.
Livestock supply the created material system on which the paired uses operate.
Riding on a mount supplies terrestrial mobility.
An edible share explicitly joins mobility to provision.
The ship moving in water supplies a second transport domain.
Bearing a visible load makes conveyance the shared function across land and water.

structural_cues: 40:79 repeats 'Allah who made for you' and distributes purpose clauses across riding and eating; 40:80 extends the sequence to needs and ships.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated benefactive syntax and explicit mobility/consumption functions; I infer that 'for you' in the focus marks an affordance-rich environment, with stability enabling rather than excluding movement. A live alternative is that the later transport examples are independent signs.

changed_reading.before: The focus habitat offers a fixed place and consumable goods.
changed_reading.after: The stable habitat is also equipped for purposeful movement, carriage, and use across land and water.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it follows the non-dominant س م و to و س م mapping and joins it to form and sign branches. It remains anchored in the focus sky, human forms, and worlds, while 40:81 explicitly supplies showing and signs. Downstream prose must present it as a branch-induced visual analogy, not as a lexical replacement or translation of السماء.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: السماء بناء وصوركم فأحسن صوركم ورب العالمين

activation_trace.role: A visible identifying mark makes the upper construction readable as a marked surface.
Configured human form supplies a second visible surface bearing intentional differentiation.
A distinguishing trace that guides recognition lets 'worlds' resonate with manifest indicators.
Divine showing supplies the act by which marked surfaces become available to observers.
Manifest signs supply the recognition category for what is shown.

changed_reading.before: Sky, body, and worlds are created objects and domains.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the built habitat and formed human body behave as marked surfaces through which their maker becomes recognizable.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This material analogy is surprising because it activates the basin-bottom branch of قرار and the fixed-water branch of برك. It remains anchored in the focus's earth, sky, provision, and blessing, and 40:13 explicitly supplies downward sky-provision. Downstream prose should qualify it as a hydraulic model of coordinated benefit, not claim that قرار or تبارك literally means a catchment here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: الأرض قرارا والسماء بناء ورزقكم من الطيبات فتبارك الله

activation_trace.role: A stable bottom or smooth basin supplies the lower receiving geometry.
Constructed assembly supplies an ordered upper component rather than random exposure.
Rain understood as provision supplies the material transferred through the system.
Water held in a pool supplies the image of benefit retained rather than immediately lost.
Downward delivery supplies the inferred arrow from upper structure to lower receiver.
The explicit sky-linked provision keeps the hydraulic analogy connected to packet evidence.

changed_reading.before: The verse coordinates architecture, food, and a concluding declaration of blessing.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it sketches a catchment economy: upper order delivers, the settled lower realm receives, and blessing is good retained long enough to nourish.

strongest_changes: The sky-building became a delivery system when 40:13 coupled descent, sky, and provision.
Earthly settlement became genuine but provisional under 40:39's contrast with the abode of settlement.
Human imaging became the culmination of measured, staged formation under 40:67.
The focus became a concrete sign-argument between 40:63's denial and 40:81's showing of signs.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah recurrence did not collapse into one theme: it activated hydrological, rhythmic, developmental, polemical, evidentiary, relational, and mobility readings around the same focus constructions.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether 40:39 limits the focus settlement or simply names a distinct later kind of settlement.
Whether the Pharaoh tower sequence is deliberate counter-architecture or a reader-supplied analogy from shared building language.
The non-dominant س م و to و س م activation and the material قرار and برك branches must remain explicitly exploratory.
